title: Covered Toilet Paper Holder With Glass Shelf Wall Mount Solid Brass | Waverly Place Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom with a covered toilet paper holder that adds a convenient glass shelf while keeping the roll protected.

  • Covered design: Helps protect tissue from moisture and dust
  • Glass shelf: Handy spot for small items and helps keep items dry
  • Solid brass construction: Built for enduring strength
  • Wall mount: Space-saving installation with concealed screws for a clean look
  • Coordinated style: Part of the Waverly Place collection for matching bath accessories

Specifications

  • Collection: Waverly Place
  • Style: Traditional
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Overall dimensions: 8.75 in L x 6 in W x 4.6 in H
  • Projection: 6 in
  • Product weight: 5.6 lb
  • Weight capacity: 250 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included items: Toilet paper holder and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
  • Finish options: Multiple designer finish options available
